description: Administrative interface for managing AI prompts and configurations. This system allows users to create, edit, and test AI prompts, specifically designed for integration with Gemini models. It includes advanced configuration options such as temperature, top-p, and model selection to fine-tune AI behavior.

pages.name: AiPromptComponent
pages.description: This page serves as the central hub for managing all AI prompts within the system. Users can create new prompts, modify existing ones, delete obsolete prompts, and thoroughly test their configurations with Gemini models. It provides tools for fine-tuning AI responses through various parameters and managing system-level prompts.

buttons.label: Clear Search
buttons.description: Resets the search filter and displays all available AI prompts in the list.
when_to_use: When you want to remove the current search filter and view the complete list of prompts.

buttons.label: New Prompt | Edit Prompt
buttons.description: Opens a dialog window to either create a brand new AI prompt or modify the details of an existing selected prompt. This includes setting the prompt's name, type, content, and model parameters.
when_to_use: When you need to define a new AI prompt for a specific purpose.
When you need to update the content, model, or parameters of an existing AI prompt.

buttons.label: Cancel
buttons.description: Closes the prompt creation or editing dialog without saving any changes made. All unsaved modifications will be lost.
when_to_use: When you decide not to save the changes you've made in the prompt dialog.
When you want to exit the dialog without creating a new prompt.

buttons.label: Test Prompt
buttons.description: Executes the currently configured prompt with a test input to validate its behavior and review the AI's response. This helps in debugging and refining prompt effectiveness.
when_to_use: When you want to verify how a prompt responds to specific inputs before saving it.
When you are debugging a prompt and need to see its output in real-time.

buttons.label: Delete
buttons.description: Initiates the process to permanently remove a selected AI prompt. A confirmation dialog will appear to warn about potential dependencies before deletion.
when_to_use: When an AI prompt is no longer needed or is incorrect and must be removed from the system. Use with caution as this action cannot be undone and may affect features relying on this prompt.

buttons.label: Upgrade Gemini Model
buttons.description: Updates all existing AI prompts to utilize the latest available version of the Gemini model. This ensures all prompts benefit from the most recent AI advancements.
when_to_use: When a new, improved version of the Gemini model is released and you want all prompts to leverage it.
When you need to standardize all prompts to a specific, newer Gemini model version.

buttons.label: Preview | Raw
buttons.description: Switches the display of test results between a user-friendly, formatted preview and the raw JSON response from the AI model. This is useful for both content review and technical debugging.
when_to_use: Switch to 'Preview' to see the AI's response rendered clearly and readably.
Switch to 'Raw' to inspect the full technical JSON output, including metadata and detailed response structure.

buttons.label: Help
buttons.description: Opens or closes a side panel containing comprehensive guidance on writing effective AI prompts, understanding markdown formatting, and configuring AI parameters.
when_to_use: When you need assistance or best practices for crafting prompts.
When you are unsure about the meaning or impact of certain AI configuration settings.

help_guidance.when_stuck: If you're having trouble, start by selecting a 'Prompt Type' and a 'Gemini Model'. Then, fill in the 'Prompt Content' field with your desired instructions. Remember to configure parameters like 'Temperature' (for creativity) and 'Top-P' (for diversity) as needed. Always use the 'Test Prompt' feature to validate your prompt's output before saving. The 'Preview' tab shows a formatted response, while the 'Raw' tab displays the technical JSON output.
common_tasks: Creating new prompt: Click 'New Prompt', choose the prompt type and Gemini model, enter your prompt content, and then save it.
Testing prompt: Select an existing prompt from the list, click 'Test Prompt', provide any necessary test input, and review the AI's response in the output panel.

Configuring model parameters: When editing a prompt, adjust 'Temperature' to control the AI's creativity (higher for more creative, lower for more factual), 'Top-P' for nucleus sampling (controls diversity of output), and 'Top-K' for token filtering (limits the number of possible next tokens).
Managing system prompts: Edit prompts that define the core behavior and responses of the AI assistant, ensuring consistent interactions.
Previewing output: After testing a prompt, use the 'Preview' tab to see a clean, formatted version of the AI's response, or switch to the 'Raw' tab to view the complete technical JSON response.
